title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Computation of the Dependency Redetermination Credit
content:
The credit booked by a dependency redetermination on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record is computed from the claim's own figures and the program's scheduled figures.

## Definition

1. **Redetermined dependency allowance.** The per-dependent amount times the dependents on record, counting no more than the program's maximum number of dependents, rounded to the cent. The per-dependent amount is the program's dependency allowance per dependent.
2. **Allowance increase.** The redetermined dependency allowance less the dependency allowance on the claim, never below zero.
3. **Credit.** The program's maximum duration weeks times the allowance increase, never more than the program's base-period-wage fraction times the base-period wages on the claim less the maximum benefit amount already on the claim. The lesser of the two figures is rounded down to the whole dollar, and the credit is never below zero.

The weeks multiply the allowance increase first; the product is then compared with the wage cap; the rounding down to the whole dollar is applied to the lesser figure.

## Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Dependents on record | The claim |
| Dependency allowance on the claim | The claim (the allowance set by the latest monetary determination) |
| Maximum benefit amount already on the claim | The claim |
| Base-period wages | The claim (the base period used by the latest monetary determination) |
| Per-dependent amount, maximum number of dependents, maximum duration weeks, base-period-wage fraction | The program's scheduled figures |

## Worked example (hypothetical claim, Regular State Unemployment Insurance figures)

A claim carries a dependency allowance of 15.00, set for one dependent; 3 dependents are now on record; base-period wages are 30000.00 and the maximum benefit amount on the claim is 9000.00. With the program's per-dependent figure of 15.00, maximum of 3 dependents, 26 maximum duration weeks and fraction of 0.3333:

- Redetermined allowance: 15.00 times 3, that is 45.00.
- Allowance increase: 45.00 less 15.00, that is 30.00.
- Weeks times increase: 26 times 30.00, that is 780.00.
- Wage cap: 0.3333 times 30000.00 is 9999.00; less 9000.00 leaves 999.00.
- Credit: the lesser of 780.00 and 999.00, rounded down, is 780.

Were the maximum benefit amount on the claim 9500.00, the wage cap would leave 499.00 and the credit would be 499. Were 5 dependents on record, no more than 3 would be counted.
